notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are in Other Governmental Funds per Exhibit C), so business_type is null. Beginning/ending cash = governmental funds beginning/ending fund balance and net position (Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds, p5; ties to Exhibit A p1 total assets). Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D total column (p5; p4 holds the fund columns). Transfers of 75,000 are eliminated by the reclassification column so the printed totals exclude them; transfers_in/out are recorded from p4 and net to zero. Attempt 2 re-check: 'Taxes: Property' 2,157,051.75 split into property tax 2,149,361.61 and penalties & interest on taxes 7,690.14 using the fund schedules (General 1110/1140 p8, Bond p15, Special Building p16, QCPU p17; exact tie); 'County receipts' 21,615.38 split into 2110 county fines and license fees 20,057.44 (Fines and Licenses) and 2210 ESU receipts 1,557.94 (p8); Exhibit P program lines follow the statement's grouping: Title I, IDEA and REAP lines (sum 174,191.50 = statement 'Federal programs') are Federal Programs and Career & Technical Education 15,000 (= statement 'State programs') is State Categorical Programs; Vehicle servicing lines are code 2730-2733 (transportation, p10), so they stay student transportation; balance sheet now from Exhibit C governmental funds balance sheet (p3, Total Governmental Funds, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal Exhibit A (3,013,556.22). 'Taxes: Other' 1,185,083.89 was split into homestead exemption, property tax credit and pro-rate motor vehicle using the fund schedules (exact tie). 'Other state receipts' 74,625.83 holds no homestead/credit/pro-rate money (General 3400/3535/3551/3990 73,827.90 + School Nutrition state reimbursements 797.93). 'Other student support' split into Activities (p13) and School Nutrition (p14) disbursements; 'Debt service' split into principal 100,000 and interest/fees 623 (Bond Fund p15); 'Non-revenue receipts' split into sale of property 719.20 (p9) and Employee Benefit other non-revenue 26,118.28 (p12). Other local receipts left as printed (charges for services/fees, review) since the printed schedules do not give an exact breakdown. Detail: Exhibit E/F General Fund components duplicates Exhibits G/H/I and was not recorded again. General Fund spending uses Exhibit P (program x object, p19-24, complete through Total Cash Disbursements 5,107,725.37 on p24) for every program; it replaces all program lines of the Exhibit G budget schedule, so nothing is double counted. Only the Exhibit G 8000 Transfers line stays under the budget schedule, whose expenditure total (p10) counts the Exhibit P lines via includes_schedules. Exhibit P lines have no budget (null). Exhibit P object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Purchased Services -> professional/contract services, Other Expenses -> miscellaneous expenditure (review; composition not printed). Exhibit G transfer 8000 (75,000) recorded as other financing -75,000 and included in the printed expenditure total 5,107,725.37. Dash amounts recorded as 0. Student Fee Fund (Exh O) had no activity.
